explication: Solace Agent Mesh is an event-driven multi-agent AI framework. The principal workflow is: a user submits a task through the Web UI, the HTTP/SSE gateway establishes session state and streams progress, orchestration delegates work to specialized agents over Solace, agents invoke LLMs and tools, and results or artifacts return through SSE to the UI. The graph also preserves documented A2A, workflows, plugins, scheduling, projects, dynamic embeds, and OAuth capabilities. Several runtime components are represented by their enclosing source directory because their specific files were not sampled.
